description: Source code for a firmware image creation utility, including functions for handling firmware blocks, checksums, and output formatting, specific to ZyXEL devices and their firmware image format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating firmware image creation based on command-line options.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the utility.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration by name.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Parses and processes the board option from command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_opt_ofname
methods.description: Parses and sets the output filename option.

methods.name: parse_opt_block
methods.description: Parses and processes block options (boot extension or raw block).

methods.name: calc_block_offsets
methods.description: Calculates offsets for firmware blocks within flash memory.

methods.name: process_blocks
methods.description: Collects file stats and calculates block offsets.

methods.name: write_out_image
methods.description: Writes the complete firmware image to output file.

methods.name: write_out_header
methods.description: Writes firmware header to output file.

methods.name: write_out_mmap
methods.description: Writes memory map information to output file.

methods.name: block_stat_file
methods.description: Gets file size for a firmware block.

methods.name: read_magic
methods.description: Reads magic number from boot extension block.

methods.name: write_out_file
methods.description: Writes file data into output firmware image.

methods.name: write_out_block
methods.description: Writes a firmware block to output file.

methods.name: write_out_data
methods.description: Writes raw data to output file and updates checksum.

methods.name: write_out_padding
methods.description: Writes padding bytes to align data in output file.

methods.name: write_out_data_align
methods.description: Writes data with alignment padding.

methods.name: csum_init
methods.description: Initializes checksum state.

methods.name: csum_update
methods.description: Updates checksum with new data.

methods.name: csum_get
methods.description: Retrieves current checksum value.

methods.name: csum_buf
methods.description: Calculates checksum of a buffer.
